services.title: Solana mint audit
services.summary: Who holds power over a Solana token: mint and freeze authority, Token-2022 extensions (permanent delegate, transfer hook, transfer fee), each named with its holder, and which of those powers are settled for good.
services.customer_value: Before accepting or holding a token, know who can mint more, freeze your balance, or move it without your signature — by mint address, never by ticker.

chain.description: Solana chain id or alias. Defaults to "solana"; a non-Solana chain is refused.

completeness.description: How much of the answer this is. Read before concluding anything is absent.

services.pricing_basis: One account read. Priced at risk.score (0.02), below token.intelligence (0.03), which adds holder data this does not.

services.title: Can this token be sold again
services.summary: Before buying a Solana token, the specific mechanisms that could stop you selling it — transfer hook, permanent delegate, live freeze authority, default-frozen accounts, non-transferability, transfer fees, concentrated supply — each with who holds the power.
services.customer_value: Names what can trap a position before it is taken, instead of a score. States plainly that it does not judge liquidity or price.

mint.description: Mint address, or an address-book alias for one.

chain.description: Solana chain id or alias. Defaults to "solana".

canExit.description: False when a mechanism can block a sale or seize the balance. True is not "safe to buy".

completeness.description: How much of the answer this is. Read before concluding anything is absent.

services.pricing_basis: Mint plus largest-holder reads (three round trips). Priced at token.intelligence and launch.check (0.03).

services.title: Check a payment demand before signing
services.summary: Takes an invoice or payment intent as it arrived and checks every claim against the chain: the destination account exists, holds that mint and belongs to the payee; the displayed and base-unit amounts agree; decimals and ticker match the token; the expiry has not passed; the mint charges no hidden transfer fee. Solana and EVM.
services.customer_value: Catches the payment that cannot do what the invoice says before it is signed — the wrong token under the right ticker, an account that does not exist, an amount off by the decimals.

to.description: The wallet the demand says will be paid.

tokenAccount.description: The exact destination token account the demand names, where it names one.

mint.description: Token address — the mint on Solana. Omit for the native asset. Never a ticker.

token.description: Alias for `mint`, for EVM chains where the token is a contract rather than a mint.

asset.description: The ticker the demand claims, e.g. USDC. Checked against `mint`, never used instead of it.

amount.description: Whole tokens as a decimal string, as the demand displays it.

amountBaseUnits.description: The same amount in base units, where the demand states both. They must agree.

decimals.description: The decimals the demand assumes. Checked against the mint.

memo.description: Text the demand says the payment must carry.

reference.description: The Solana Pay reference that would make the payment findable.

expiresAt.description: When the demand stops being valid, ISO 8601.

chain.description: Chain id or alias, EVM or Solana. Defaults to "solana".

services.pricing_basis: A few account reads. Priced at transaction.simulate (0.02) and deliberately low: it only protects a buyer who runs it before every payment.

services.title: Prove a payment met its demand
services.summary: After paying, prove from the chain alone that the payment met the demand it answered: payee, mint, exact token account, amount, memo, deadline and payer, each checked against the finalized transaction with expected and observed side by side. Solana.
services.customer_value: Evidence a payer assembles without the payee's cooperation — the answer to "it never arrived", "it arrived late" or "it went to the wrong account", in a form anyone holding the signature can re-derive.

signature.description: The signature of the payment transaction.

to.description: The wallet the demand said would be paid. Matched by token-account owner.

amount.description: Whole tokens as a decimal string, as the demand stated it.

mint.description: Token address — the mint. Omit for native SOL. Never a ticker.

tokenAccount.description: The exact destination token account the demand named, where it named one.

memo.description: Text the demand said the payment must carry.

expiresAt.description: When the demand stopped being valid, ISO 8601. The payment must have landed before it.

from.description: The wallet that should have paid. Checked against whoever the funds left.

chain.description: Solana chain id or alias. Defaults to "solana".

verdict.description: `unproven` means the chain could not settle it yet, never that it is wrong.

services.pricing_basis: One finalized transaction read. Priced at token.intelligence (0.03), below transaction.explain (0.05).

services.title: Multi-tool investigation with an evidence trail
services.summary: One subject, one stated objective — identify, holdings, activity, settlement, payment, safety or liveness — answered by a searched sequence of up to 16 read-only calls, returning the facts, the exact path that proved them, and an explicit list of what could not be proved and why.
services.customer_value: A multi-step answer whose gaps are named instead of guessed over, and which is reproducible: two runs against the same chain state take the same path, and every step records the call and arguments that produced it.

subject.description: What the question is about: an address, transaction hash, ENS/SNS name, Solana mint, alias, or — for the `liveness` objective — a chain id.

objective.description: What counts as an answer. This decides which facts the search is trying to prove, and therefore which tools it will reach for.

chain.description: Chain id or alias, when you already know it. Saves the search from inferring it, and narrows every move after.

maxCalls.description: Hard ceiling on tool calls. Defaults to 8, capped at 16. The only argument that spends anything.

beam.description: How many moves may run at once in one wave. Defaults to 3, capped at 5. Higher finishes sooner and can spend calls on moves a slower wave would have skipped.

to.description: The wallet the demand said would be paid.

amount.description: Whole tokens, as the demand stated it.

mint.description: Token mint. Omit for native SOL.

tokenAccount.description: The exact destination token account, where named.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 deadline the payment must land before.

from.description: The wallet that should have paid.

demand.description: For the `payment` objective: the terms the transaction in `subject` is held to. Without it, the proof is listed in `unproven` with the reason.

budget.description: How much of each list to return: 'small' (10 items, for a tight context), 'standard' (the default), 'full' (this source's maximum), or a number for an exact count. Omitting it changes nothing. Anything cut is reported in `completeness` as truncated with counts, never dropped silently.

plan.description: Return the order the moves would be attempted in, and what each would cost, without calling anything. A plan assumes every move answers in full, which a real run cannot.

verdict.description: About the evidence, never about the subject.

path.description: Each step: tool, exact arguments, facts proved, reward.

completeness.description: How much of the answer this is. Read before concluding anything is absent.

services.pricing_basis: Up to eight calls by default, sixteen at most, for one flat price. Priced at contract.inspect (0.08), below research.asset (0.10).
